title: I Returned the Expired Ski-Wax Hold Ticket With the Promise Date Circled

parts.text: I brought the hold ticket back at 4:12 p.m. with the promise date circled in the same pen they used. The counter said the wax job was still in back. I was thirty, season renter, holding a numbered bag they had tagged April. The slip said READY BY TUESDAY. It was Friday. I photographed the circle, the bag, and the board that still listed my name. Then I asked for the hold log. The manager refunded the wax and dated the next slip in front of me. I keep the circle photo. The board finally knows a Tuesday from a Friday.

social.video_title: The ski-wax hold was still April on a Friday — Part 1/1
social.description: Promise date circled, numbered bag, a board that still listed me. Would you have asked for the hold log?
